rating_definitions.substantial: Source-critical coherent explanation plus independent document locators and validated spatial observation
rating_definitions.developing: Explanatory mechanism and site are meaningful but primary/archive or map gap remains
rating_definitions.sparse: Some differentiated observations without enough evidence for a full chapter/site walk
rating_definitions.missing: Essential explanatory or physical evidence absent

cells.theme: Flooding, crop disease and food-price vulnerability
cells.explanatory_readiness: Explanatory causal chain from named chronicles is present, but no quantitative environmental/price series.
cells.next_evidence_needed: Contemporary alcabala, alhóndiga and epidemic returns; check flood chronology.
